businesses.business: health savings accounts and benefits administration

offering_description.value: HealthEquity provides health savings accounts and administers employee benefits for employers, health plans and individuals. It holds HSA assets as a nonbank custodian and lets members manage contributions, spending and investments through a digital platform. It also administers flexible spending, health reimbursement, commuter benefits and COBRA continuation coverage.

primary_services.value: health savings account custody and administration; flexible spending account administration; health reimbursement arrangement administration; COBRA administration; commuter benefits administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers, health plans and third-party benefits administrators; B2C: individual health savings account holders; B2G: government agencies purchasing benefits administration for employees

end_markets.value: employer-sponsored benefits; consumer healthcare savings and spending; health insurance; commuter benefits

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: yield paid by depository partners on HSA cash balances, net of interest credited to members; service fees: account custody, investment administration and employee benefits administration; transaction or usage fees: interchange on purchases made with benefit debit cards
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: holds member HSA assets and connects account holders with deposit and investment options; service provider: processes enrollment, claims and reimbursements for employers and plan participants

specialization.value: related lines: HSA custody, flexible spending and health reimbursement accounts, COBRA and commuter benefits

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving employers and health plans; partners / resellers: health plans and third-party benefits administrators offering accounts to clients and members; agents / brokers: employee benefits brokers and consultants; online: website enrollment for individual HSA holders
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; agents / brokers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: IRS approval for nonbank HSA custody, federal tax rules for benefit accounts and COBRA continuation requirements
